linux.post_install: # steamclient.so for the Steam API (LinuxGSM fix_steamcmd.sh does the same). for bits in 64 32; do lib="$(find . "$HOME/.steam" "$HOME/.local/share/Steam" -maxdepth 4 -path "*linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)" if [ -z "$lib" ]; then lib="$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -path "*steamcmd/linux$bits/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null | head -n 1)"; fi if [ -n "$lib" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits" ln -sf "$(readlink -f "$lib")" "$HOME/.steam/sdk$bits/steamclient.so" fi done mkdir -p "Tower/Binaries/Linux" && cp -f "$HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so" "Tower/Binaries/Linux/steamclient.so" 2> /dev/null || true
